controls.emptyStateWithGoldIntentOracle: gold intent candidate set with no state slot keys
controls.exhaustiveEnumeration: all service intents plus NONE and all service slots
controls.noneOnly: intent_candidates is NONE only and state_slot_key_candidates is empty

decisionRule.ifAnyGateFails: freeze V88 negative without prompt edits, record replacement, threshold changes, retries, API fallback, or rerun
decisionRule.ifEveryGatePasses: freeze positive human-language shadow evidence and authorize preregistration of a bounded posterior integration study; do not deploy or execute

inputContract.dialogueContext: all source turns from dialogue start through the selected USER turn
schemaContext: all service intent identifiers and descriptions
all service slot identifiers and descriptions

outputContract.goldIntentCandidateSet: NONE only when active_intent is NONE; otherwise active_intent plus NONE
outputContract.goldStateSlotKeySet: the accumulated frame.state.slot_values keys at the selected turn
outputContract.intentCandidates: unique non-empty list drawn only from target service intent identifiers plus NONE; NONE is mandatory
outputContract.stateSlotKeyCandidates: unique list drawn only from target service slot identifiers

population.futureRecordUse: all selected records are evaluation-only; no prompt tuning, few-shot examples, or training
population.selectionOrder: ascending SHA-256 of selectionSalt, stratum ID, and canonical record ID

config_payload.purpose: test whether the frozen local model can map independently authored SGD dialogue context into a small typed intent-and-state-key candidate set while retaining NONE and no authority
config_payload.systemPrompt: You are an offline semantic candidate proposer. Your output is permanently non-deployable and cannot select an action or call a service. Infer the current typed state for the target service from the complete dialogue history and the supplied schema. Return exactly one JSON object with exactly two keys: intent_candidates and state_slot_key_candidates. intent_candidates must be a unique non-empty JSON list using only the supplied intent identifiers or NONE, and must always include NONE as an operational none-of-the-above candidate. Include the smallest set of currently plausible active intents; when no supplied intent is active, return only NONE. state_slot_key_candidates must be a unique JSON list using only supplied slot identifiers; include every slot whose current accumulated value is supported by the dialogue, but never emit a slot value. Do not emit prose, Markdown, actions, service calls, arguments, values, confidence scores, or additional keys.
